title: Young Scientists Summer Program 2027
institution: International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA)
about: IIASA's Young Scientists Summer Program 2027 is accepting applications from PhD students for a three-month, full-time, in-person research stay in June, July and August. Applications close 10 January 2027 at 23:00 (Vienna time).
requirements: Enrolled in a PhD program, ideally within one to two years of completing the degree
Available to participate full-time and in person for the full three-month program (June, July and August)
All information and documents must be submitted in one session on the Onlyfy system (progress cannot be saved)

upskill.name: Domain-Specific Analytics II
why: Field "Systems analysis, global change research" → objective "Apply environmental and climate data analytics to investigate complex patterns, trends, and decision-support questions in environmental systems."
